Asaph Kotzin

Flagsmith

📌 [...] Hi Product Hunt, I'm Asaph, Head of Product at Flagsmith. Product and Engineering teams have been using Flagsmith flags for years to release safely. Plenty of them already split traffic with our multivariate flags, and then try to track and join exposure and conversion events using other tools to see whether the change worked. Many teams stop before getting any results, or find the process so complicated that they never try again. So we built the other half into Flagsmith - Today we’re launching Flagsmith Experiments as a public beta, in the open-source core and on Flagsmith Cloud. How it works: - Start from an A/B flag you already run, in your code, using our SDKs - Connect your warehouse - we currently support ClickHouse and Databricks, and BigQuery and Snowflake will be available soon.
